title: China Claims Philippine Military Aircraft 'Intruded' Into South China Sea Airspace Near Pag-asa
detail: China's military claimed a Philippine military aircraft 'intruded' into airspace over disputed South China Sea waters, further raising tensions following recent coast guard confrontations near Pag-asa (Thitu) Island. The claim marks the latest in a series of aerial challenges in the Spratlys, where China has repeatedly issued verbal warnings and fired flares at Philippine patrol aircraft in 2026.

title: Philippines Accuses Chinese J-16 of Repeatedly Approaching Patrol Cessna Near Thitu
detail: Manila accused Chinese military and coast guard units of harassing Philippine government aircraft and boats near Scarborough Shoal and the Spratlys. A Chinese J-16 fighter allegedly repeatedly approached a Philippine Cessna 208 on patrol, while a China Coast Guard vessel tried to block Filipino fishers near Thitu (Pag-asa) on Oct 4.
